title: 🎨 Card Preset
description: A named look & feel for a card: the combined attributes placed on the <ui-card> or <ui-reveal> element itself (variant, media, content token strings — plus reveal-specific attributes). Cards reference a preset instead of owning presentation, so restyling any card is a single reference swap. Presets are design-system data: invariant, not localized.

layout.name: Attributes
layout.description: Token strings written verbatim to the element's attributes

layout.name: Reveal
layout.description: Only used when element is ui-reveal

layout.name: Carousel
layout.description: Only used when element is lay-out

internalName.title: Internal Name
internalName.description: Internal name for CMS editors — not displayed on the front end

element.title: Element
element.description: Host element the attributes are applied to. ui-card is the host; ui-media and ui-content are its two areas (media / text) and can also be used bare — a standalone media frame or text column living directly in a layout, with no card chrome. "content" names the text area, not the card.

options.label: <lay-out overflow> — a scroller deck, one card per part (quiz)

variant.title: variant=
variant.description: Card composition tokens: col | col-r | row | row-r, spl(1/2 …), ovr(tl…br), vis(media|content), rds(…)

theme.title: theme=
theme.description: Shared theme axis: one colour (red orange green blue accent white gray slate black) + optional modifiers pale | muted | light | dark. E.g. "black dark", "red pale", "gray". See ui/base/theme.md.

media.title: media=
media.description: Media frame tokens: asr(16/9 …), obf(), obp(), hov(), scm, clip … Carousel controls live here too — the ONLY form (no nav=/arrow=/dot= attributes): bare nav (markers + arrows), nav(mrk|arw|blw|abv), arw(arr|sm|lg|xl|sqr|sft|hid|lgt|drk|bare|set|ts…be|blw|abv), mrk(sm|md|lg|xl|pll|hyb|tmb|non|lgt|drk|ts…be|blw|abv), axis(y), auto, auto(4s), loop, stagger. Furniture styling also lives here, as single-value tokens (the CSS matches them by substring, so combine one value per token, not chip(ts red)): position chip|sticker|save|play|beacon(ts…be); hue chip|sticker|save|beacon(red|orange|green|blue|accent|white|gray|slate|black); sticker shape sticker(sh:burst|sh:spark|sh:sunburst|sh:heart|sh:blob|text|spl|spr) — clip silhouettes use the sh: prefix, custom ones too (sticker(sh:myshape) + inline --ui-sticker-clip-path); chip variant chip(lgt|out) and size chip(sm|lg|xl|2xl); save size save(sm|lg|xl) and disc save(crc|sqr|rnd|non); play size play(sm|lg|xl); beacon face beacon(dts|pll|sld|tck), animation beacon(bln|pls|brt|non), size beacon(xs|sm|md|lg|xl|2xl) and corner beacon(rnd|sqr). The renderer emits the furniture elements from the card's content.furniture object and appends each item's optional style= override after these tokens (a same-axis override replaces the preset's token).

media-open.title: media-open=
media-open.description: Lightbox open-state control vocabulary — ordinary media= carousel-control spellings (nav/mrk/arw/tmb/axis tokens only) that REPLACE the media= control words while the popover lightbox is open, e.g. "axis(y) nav(mrk) mrk(tmb) mrk(rail)" for the vertical thumbnail rail. Swapped in by ui/card/lightbox.js and restored on close; without JS the open lightbox keeps the closed nav style. Only emitted when the preset's card carries lightbox furniture.

content.title: content=
content.description: Text column tokens: scl(sm|md|lg|xl), pad(), gap(), scr

text.title: Text mode
text.description: Which long text the text column shows: summary (teaser — the default for cards), body (full view — the body replaces the summary; falls back to summary when no body exists), or both. Reveal back panels always render both.

headingTag.title: Headline element
headingTag.description: Heading level for the headline: h3 (default), or h2/h4/h5 to fit the host page's outline. Heading LEVEL is placement, not content, which is why it lives here. An ovr() overlay card always renders <strong> instead — an overlay headline is a label, not a section heading.

byline.title: Byline placement
byline.description: Where the author byline sits in the text column: tail (default — after the summary/body and details, the teaser shape) or lede (right after the summary, carrying the dateline — the full-article shape; the tail then renders neither byline nor dateline). The book type places its byline early regardless.

parts.title: Sub-component variants
parts.description: Variant words written to sub-components the renderer emits inside the text column. parts.quote → variant on <ui-quote> (bigquote / breaker / code; the quote type defaults to bigquote when omitted, review/social to none). parts.accordion → variant on <ui-accordion> (bordered / divided / rounded / pill / separate / filled, space-separable) for faq items, recipe instructions and job requirements/benefits; the word popover is a MODE, not chrome — the renderer swaps <details>/<summary> for <button popovertarget> + <div popover> pairs (native Popover API, no JS; for recipe/howto that is the outer Instructions/Steps wrapper, the inner steps stay an accordion inside the panel) and the remaining words still style the host. parts.buttonGroup → data-variant on the .ui-button-group variant picker (inline / rounded / border / outline; defaults to "inline rounded border", the segmented control) when details.variants.control is "buttons". Unknown words are dead in the browser — tokens.lint.js validates against the component vocabularies.

styles.title: Style overrides
styles.description: CSS custom properties written to the element's style attribute, e.g. { "--ui-reveal-content-bg": "#1f2937" }. Keys must start with --.

carousel.title: Carousel
carousel.description: Scroller-deck configuration — only used when element is lay-out. The renderer emits one <ui-card> slide per part (a graded Quiz's questions) inside <lay-out overflow>, with the Quiz's own properties on a wrapping <section>; variant/media/content above configure each slide. Anything that is not a multiple-choice quiz falls back to the single card with an HTML comment.

media.title: media= (scroller)
media.description: The lay-out's own control token string — the same media= vocabulary as a card frame: nav(end) puts dots + arrows inside each slide's content end, arw(drk) fills the arrows, and the bare gate token keeps the next arrow disabled until the current slide's question is answered (one required radio per question). Default: nav(end).

reveal.title: Reveal
reveal.description: Reveal configuration — only used when element is ui-reveal. The renderer folds these into compact variant= tokens where the animation carries its own direction: type+from → one token (expand → exp, flip+top → flp(top), slide+left → sld(lft), scale → grw), typeLg → lg:-prefixed swap (lg:grw), to → pop, trigger card → trg(card), scroll → scr; icon/iconClose positional words fold into one corner token — ts|te|bs|be ("top right" → ico(te)) plus style tokens (dark → drk, semi → sem, sm, lg). iconType stays markup (the toggle <ui-icon type>).

typeLg.title: type-lg=
typeLg.description: Reveal type override at the large container tier (e.g. expand on mobile, scale on desktop)

to.title: to=
to.description: Expand target — pop the panel to the viewport instead of in place

icon.title: icon=
icon.description: Toggle-icon tokens: position (top bottom left right) · style (dark semi) · size (sm lg), e.g. “top right sm”

iconType.title: Icon glyph
iconType.description: Glyph of the toggle <ui-icon> in the summary. Directional arrow-cross glyphs pair with slide reveals (panel from top → down-arrow-cross, bottom → up, left → right, right → left).

iconClose.title: icon-close=
iconClose.description: Close-icon tokens, e.g. “dark” or “dark top right”

name.title: name=
name.description: Exclusive-accordion group — reveals sharing a name close each other (native <details name>). Omit for independent reveals; the renderer never defaults it
